spots.name: The Order of the Spheres
spots.blurb: You've reached The Order of the Spheres, a mural by Roberto Juarez from 2010. This dome covers wind tunnel equipment. It is decorated with a painted mural by Roberto Juarez titled "The Order of the Spheres", completed 2010 and dedicated 2011-09-16. There is a plaque on the lawn near Hayward Street.
